SELECT t.id, t.title, t.author_id, u.username AS author_name, t.view_count, t.is_pinned, t.is_active, t.created_at, t.updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM topic_comments WHERE topic_id = t.id) AS comment_count FROM topics t INNER JOIN users u ON t.author_id = u.id WHERE t.is_active = true
AND (t.title ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR t.content_plain ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY t.is_pinned DESC, t.created_at DESC

SELECT t.id, t.title, t.content, t.content_plain, t.author_id, u.username AS author_name, t.view_count, t.is_pinned, t.is_active, t.created_at, t.updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM topic_comments WHERE topic_id = t.id) AS comment_count FROM topics t INNER JOIN users u ON t.author_id = u.id WHERE t.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO topics (title, content, content_plain, author_id, author_name) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{contentPlain}, #{authorId}, (SELECT username FROM users WHERE id = #{authorId}))
mapper.update: UPDATE topics SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, content_plain = #{contentPlain}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE topics SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE topics SET is_pinned = #{isPinned}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
